subject: Expansion: additional teams & key segmentation for Clearline Health
messages:
From: Jordan Meyer <jmeyer@clearline.health>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:12:00-05:00
Subject: Expansion inquiry: new projects & API key segmentation

Hi Rachel,

We are planning to roll Redwood out to three additional internal products over the next two quarters and wanted to confirm the onboarding flow and pricing implications. High-level: 3 new projects (mobile app, patient-portal, analytics pipeline), estimated combined usage ~1.5M tokens/month initially, with expected peak spikes up to 3M in month 3.

Two specific asks:
- We need separate API keys per product/environment (prod/staging) — is there a quota or limit per account for keys?
- If we increase committed capacity, what are the term/discount options? Our procurement and legal teams will want to see an addendum rather than a full contract rewrite.

Can we schedule a 30-min call to map rollout responsibilities and timelines? Next week works for us (any day except Tuesday).

Thanks,
Jordan Meyer
Director of Engineering
Clearline Health

--
Jordan Meyer
Jordan.Meyer@clearline.health
From: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyer <jmeyer@clearline.health>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-25T09:43:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Expansion inquiry: new projects & API key segmentation

Jordan — thanks for the context, and congrats on the expansion. Looping in Monica (CS lead) and Vivek (AE) so we can scope rollout + commercial options.

Quick answers up front:
- We support per-project and per-environment keys; there is no hard limit but we recommend a key-per-app and a separate key-per-environment pattern for observability and blast-radius control.
- For committed capacity increases we typically provide an addendum (short-form) with volume tiers and a limited-term discount. Marcus from sales ops will draft a proposal once we confirm volumes.

Next steps I propose:
1) Monica will draft an onboarding matrix (owners, milestones, key naming conventions, and capacity forecasts).
2) Vivek will run a pricing sketch and put together a recommended addendum (term options: 6-month ramp vs 12-month commit).
3) Schedule a 30-min call — Wed 2026-11-27 at 10:00 AM ET or Thu 2026-11-28 at 11:00 AM ET. Which works?

If you can share the procurement contact and any SSO/KMS constraints, that will help us pre-fill the addendum.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
Rachel.Kim@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 (415) 555-0134

On 2026-11-25 09:12, Jordan Meyer wrote:
> We are planning to roll Redwood out to three additional internal products over the next two quarters...
From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyer <jmeyer@clearline.health>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-26T11:25:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Expansion inquiry: new projects & API key segmentation

Jordan — attaching a first-pass onboarding matrix and phased rollout plan (attachment: clearline_onboarding_matrix_v1.xlsx). High level:

Phase A (Weeks 0-4):
- Provision keys: 3 prod keys, 3 staging keys, 1 shared analytics key (naming convention: CLINE-<project>-<env>).
- Owner: Eng lead (Jordan). CS will enable tracing, rate-limits, and tag examples for token accounting.
- Expected baseline: 1.5M tokens/mo.

Phase B (Weeks 5-12):
- Load testing and prefix caching enabled for patient-portal and analytics pipeline.
- Rollout can be throttled by percentage; recommend 10% increments every 3 days.
- Add monitoring alerts to the Redwood Console (latency > 200ms or token burn > forecast +25%).

Governance notes:
- Key rotation cadence: quarterly for prod keys; staging monthly.
- If you want delegated key creation, we can provision scoped service accounts with limited privileges.

Capacity forecast (conservative / expected / peak):
- Baseline: 1.5M / month
- Expected month-3: 2.2M / month
- Peak window (month-3 burst): up to 3M tokens/day for 2-3 days during campaign runs

I've included fields in the sheet for billing contact, legal contact, SSO requirements, and preferred addendum term. Please fill those and we will fold them into the pricing proposal.

Best,
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.ai

On 2026-11-25 09:43, Rachel Kim wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the context, and congrats on the expansion...
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Meyer <jmeyer@clearline.health>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-27T08:00:00-05:00
Subject: Pricing addendum (sketch) for CL-8421

Jordan — following up with a commercial sketch so you have something for procurement. Attachment: SLA_addendum_draft.pdf (PDF with redlines).

Option A — 12-month commit (recommended):
- +30% committed token capacity on top of existing baseline
- 10% unit price discount on token rates for committed volume
- Quarterly reconciliation; unused committed tokens do not rollover but are applied to overage at discounted rate

Option B — 6-month ramp:
- Month 1-2: committed +15% (no discount)
- Month 3-6: committed +30% with 5% discount on committed volume

Other notes:
- We can issue a clean addendum that amends the current Master Services Agreement; no full contract rewrite required.
- If procurement requires 60-day payment terms, we will need to route via sales finance and potentially add a small uplift to cover extended terms.

Next actions for Redwood:
1) Finalize addendum text and send DocuSign link.
2) Provide an updated invoice template and PO instructions (if they need a separate legal name / billing address).

Marcus Lin
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-11-29T13:15:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Pricing addendum (sketch) for CL-8421

Marcus / Rachel — thanks for the options. Procurement notes and requests:

- We need the addendum to include a clause preventing automatic renewal unless explicitly approved by Clearline procurement.
- Can you provide an updated quote showing the uplift for 60-day payment terms?
- Legal will want to redline the SLA PDF — please send as an editable DOCX or a shared Drive link so we can insert comments.

For the onboarding matrix: thanks Monica, that looks good. A couple of clarifications:
- For key rotation, we prefer a managed-key option via our KMS. Can Redwood support customer-managed keys?
- Please include an example key naming scheme in the sheet.

I'll set up a procurement/legal working session next Tue (2026-12-02). Who from Redwood should join?

Regards,
Procurement Team
Clearline Health
procurement@clearline.health
